title: At work
description: Talk about your job, tasks, and workplace routines.

introduction.headline: Navigate the workplace
introduction.body: Learn vocabulary for jobs, deadlines, and team communication at work.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara vocabolario per lavoro, scadenze e comunicazione in team.
objectives: Use the Present Perfect for work experience

vocabulary.example: My colleague helped me with the report.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il mio collega mi ha aiutato con il report.

exercises.explanation: A deadline is the last day or time to finish something.

exercises.prompt: We have ____ the project this week.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: We have ____ the project this week.
exercises.explanation: Use Present Perfect (have finished) for a recent completed action.

review.tip: Describe your job in three sentences using colleague and project.
